content: Fiye 46:1-34 Yakop Isipde Uguk.
Kaŋ Isilae adi ne’walaŋ nemenemek hogohogok tiulidokooŋ moŋgodapmaaŋ Isipde moŋgola uguk. Wooŋ Beasiba yopmaŋ usuwaaŋ Beu Aisak’walaŋ Bepaŋ muni heemiŋguk.
Kaŋ Bepaŋdi timiŋ lihine foloŋ Isilae indiŋ niŋguk, “Yakop, Yakop!” Adibo yoguk, “Nu yoŋ eeŋ.”
Kaŋ yoguk, “Nu baha’walaŋ Bepaŋ. Ale du Isipde wene munta mu tibeŋ. Nu uŋoŋ gehitubulodawene kisaŋ ulihakaaŋ me bop wapum fee tibaaŋ.
Nu dukut Isip kwetneŋ noŋgoŋ wooŋ hatibaat, hatigane kotigoŋ gehitubuudanewaat. Yosep negoŋ kohoŋdi dauge tiŋafooŋ kufulaawaak.”

Unduŋ nimbuune Yakop adi Beasiba bikabuŋa pilalune mihiŋiye beehik eŋ wapmihihiye eŋ taamuhiye wanakaŋ kale wosidi kaali hamaneyagiŋ foloŋ yapmeune logiŋ. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, Felodi Yakop nagitdok kale wosidi kaali hamaneyagiŋ kameune buguk foloŋ logiŋ.
Tiŋa yalakihiye eŋ nemenemek Kanaaŋ kwetneŋ hatilune mintayemgiŋ kaleehiye u wanaŋ moŋgola uge uge Isip kwetneŋ usuwagiŋ. Yakop eŋ yalakiŋiye hogohogok
mihiŋiŋ wabiŋiye eŋ laaŋiye wanaŋ hogohogok Isip kwetneŋ yanagila uguk.
Kaŋ yoŋadi Isilae yalakiŋiye Isip kwetneŋ usuwagiŋ adi’walaŋ wouhik habet. Yakop mihiŋiye hinek: Luben Yakop mihiŋiŋ tuo.
Luben mihiŋiye: Hanok, Pallu, Heslon eŋ Kami.
Simeon mihiŋiye: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar, eŋ Shaul. Kanaaŋ tam’walaŋ mihi.
Lewi mihiŋiye: Gelson, Kohat, eŋ Melat.
Yuda mihiŋiye: Elo, Onan, Sila, Peles tiŋa Sela. Iŋgoŋ oŋ, Elo eŋ Onan adi Kanaaŋ kwetneŋ kumuŋgumuk. Peles mihiŋiyat: Heslon eŋ Hamul.
Isaka mihiŋiye: Tola, Pua, Yasup eŋ Simlon.
Sebulun mihiŋiye: Seled, Elon eŋ Yaleel.
Yoŋ adi Leadi Padan Alam kwetneŋ hatiŋila Yakopdok yanagilimiŋguk. Wabiŋiŋ Daina maaŋ. Kunakunathik kiulune 33 tuguk.
Gad mihiŋiye: Sephon, Haggi, Suni, Esbon, Eli, Alodi eŋ Aleli.
Ase mihiŋiye: Imna, Iswa, Iswi eŋ Belia. Wihik Sela. Belia mihiŋiye: Hebe eŋ Makiel.
Yakop’walaŋ wapmihi 16 yoŋ adi Silpadi yanagikuk. Silpa adi Labandi wabiŋiŋ Leadok tipilapilaye wabi miŋguk.
Yakop taamuŋiŋ Lesel’walaŋ mihiŋiyat: Yosep, eŋ Benyamin.
Yosep mihiŋiyat: Manase eŋ Eflaim adi yadi Isip kwetneŋ mintagumuk. Isipniŋ me loloŋnit Potifela adi’walaŋ wabiŋiŋ Asenat yanagikuk.
Benyamin mihiŋiye: Bela, Beke, Asbel, Gela, Naaman, Ehi, Los, Mupim, Hupim eŋ Ad.
Yakop’walaŋ mihiŋiye 14 yoŋ adi Leseldi yanagikuk.
Dan mihiŋiŋ: Husin.
Naftali mihiŋiye: Yasiel, Guni, Yesel, eŋ Silem.
Yakop’walaŋ mihiŋiye 7 yoŋ adi Bilhadi yanagikuk. Bilha adi Labandi wabiŋiŋ Leseldok tipilapilaye wabiŋiŋ miŋguk.
Metam Yakob ne’walaŋ yalakiŋiye mintagiŋ hogohogok yehikunatneene 66 tuguk. Yakop mihiŋiye’walaŋ tamhiye’walaŋ kunakunat adi iŋaŋ mu tomboyouliŋit.
Yosep’walaŋ mihiyat Isip kwetneŋ mintagumuk adi lufom hogok. Biyagoŋ hinek Yakop’walaŋ meeŋimeeŋiye Isip kwetneŋ budapmagiŋ kunakunathik 70.
Taalipmeŋ uŋila Yakop adi Yuda niŋkulune Yosep nimbeene timeŋ uguk. Adi wooŋ nimbuune Goseŋ kwetneŋ wek yoŋa unduŋ tuguk.
Yosep adi yobune kalis tiulidokomimbuune looŋ beu Isilae kawene Goseŋ kwetneŋ uguk. Wooŋ kaŋ tobooŋa kisaŋ kookuk.
Kaŋ Isilaedi Yosep indiŋ niŋguk, “Du kaipmuŋ hatilune gabulat doktiŋa kedem walane lodaune kumumbaat.”
Kaŋ Yosepdi daliye eŋ beu’walaŋ meeŋimeeŋiye indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nu Felo wooŋ kaŋ indiŋ nimbit, ‘Datneye eŋ baatne’walaŋ meeŋimeeŋiye adi Kanaaŋ kwetneŋ hatigiŋ ala nu’walaŋkade bugiŋ.
Tiŋa adi yadi dompa yabudoko tiŋila makau kwanai maaŋ tiiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa dompa eŋ makauhiye wanaŋ yanagila bugiŋ.’
Kaŋ Felodi hanihehamaneŋ, ‘Hidi maŋgoŋ kwanai tiiŋ’

haninadiune indiŋ nineeŋ, ‘Tipilapilayegeye indi yadi beetniye dabugoŋ. Ala kuyahineeŋgoŋ kale kwanai tububihila tugumundi tiyam.’ Hidi unduŋ yoneŋ kaŋ Gosen kwetneŋ hatidok hanindapmawek. Isiphi me dompa makau kwanai tiiŋ meeniŋ undihidok adi nadiyembuune maadimaadikeeŋgoŋ tilak.”
